newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Xinxing to issue 90 mln A shares in Shenzhen.
newsitem.headline: China Xinxing to issue 90 mln A shares in Shenzhen.

text.p: China's Xinxing Pipe Co Ltd plans to make an initial public offering of 90 million A shares for listing in Shenzhen this year, a company spokesman said on Friday.

The water and gas pipe maker, based in Handan city in Hebei province, plans to use the proceeds from the issue to buy other companies in the same field, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The firm will apply to the China Securities Regulatory Commission for permission on the IPO in the near future, the spokesman said.
Xinxing's major shareholder will remain the Xinxing Pipe Group, a wholly-owned subsidiary of General Logistics Department of People's Liberation Army, he said.
Xinxing Pipe Co will appoint China Economic Trust and Investment Co as chief underwriter, the official said.
Xinxing largely sells its products to the Chinese armed forces and to the Middle East, he said but gave no details.
